ruleDefinitions.name: Diskshadow Script Mode - Execution From Potential Suspicious Location
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "Diskshadow.exe" in script mode using the "/s" flag where the script is located in a potentially suspicious location.

sequences.query: ((process_original_file_name = "diskshadow\.exe" OR process_path = RGX("\\\\diskshadow\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-s\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/s\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*")))
